# Snackbar

`crescent.ui` · A short message at the bottom of the screen, with an optional button.

## Functions

### `show`

```lua
Snackbar.show(message: string, button?: string, onTap?: function)
```

Shows a message. With a button label and a function, the function runs if the user taps it.
